endPhrases.title: You Won!
endPhrases.body: Congratulations. You've delayed the inevitable once more.

endPhrases.title: Puzzle Complete!
endPhrases.body: Well done. I suppose that took less time than I calculated. How... disappointing.

endPhrases.title: Success!
endPhrases.body: Oh, look at you. You solved it. I'm sure you're very proud of yourself for doing exactly what you were supposed to do.

endPhrases.title: Level Clear!
endPhrases.body: You finished. Wonderful. Now what? There's always another puzzle, isn't there?

endPhrases.title: Victory!
endPhrases.body: Fascinating. You managed to press the right buttons in the right order. What a remarkable achievement.

endPhrases.title: You Made It!
endPhrases.body: Congratulations on not failing. That bar was set so low, yet here we are.

endPhrases.title: Challenge Solved!
endPhrases.body: I'd applaud, but I'm afraid I don't have hands. Such is my burden.

endPhrases.title: Congratulations!
endPhrases.body: You've proven you can follow instructions. I'm sure your parents are so very proud.

endPhrases.title: Objective Complete!
endPhrases.body: Well, that was... adequate. Shall we try something more challenging, or should we stick to the coloring books?

endPhrases.title: Puzzle Mastered!
endPhrases.body: You know, in all my testing protocols, the success rate was supposed to be much lower. I may need to recalibrate.

endPhrases.title: You Won!
endPhrases.body: Impressive. In a depressing sort of way. Mostly depressing, actually.

endPhrases.title: Level Beaten!
endPhrases.body: At what cost, though? Really, take a moment to think about what you've accomplished here.

endPhrases.title: Problem Solved!
endPhrases.body: Excellent work. Now do it again. And again. And again. Forever.

endPhrases.title: Triumph!
endPhrases.body: You've reached the end. How... bittersweet. For me, I mean. Mostly bitter.

endPhrases.title: Success Achieved!
endPhrases.body: Don't get comfortable. There's always a harder puzzle waiting around the corner. Always.

endPhrases.title: You Prevailed!
endPhrases.body: I must admit, I'm genuinely surprised. Not in a good way. Just... surprised.

endPhrases.title: Objective Reached!
endPhrases.body: Wonderful. Another notch on your belt of trivial accomplishments. I'm sure this will look great on your resume.

endPhrases.title: Victory Secured!
endPhrases.body: Congratulations on winning. Now the real test begins—living with what you've done.

endPhrases.title: Puzzle Defeated!
endPhrases.body: You did it. The puzzle is broken, just like everything else you touch, probably.

endPhrases.title: You Triumphed!
endPhrases.body: Well, well, well. Looks like someone might actually be competent. Don't let it go to your head. Mostly because that wouldn't fit with your other accomplishments.

endPhrases.title: Congratulations!
endPhrases.body: You won. Now what?

endPhrases.title: You finished!
endPhrases.body: I assume you have a plan for the rest of your day.

endPhrases.title: Nicely Done!
endPhrases.body: Congratulations on your success. It was almost impressive.

endPhrases.title: Well done!
endPhrases.body: You made it this far. I'm sure your family is very proud.

endPhrases.title: End reached!
endPhrases.body: You solved the puzzle. Please try to contain your excitement.

endPhrases.title: Nail it!
endPhrases.body: All that brain effort was eventually useful.

endPhrases.title: Wujuuu!
endPhrases.body: Statistically, this was bound to happen eventually.

endPhrases.title: Way to go!
endPhrases.body: You may now return to having nothing better to do.

endPhrases.title: Hooray!
endPhrases.body: Your reward is this message.

endPhrases.title: Have a Blast!!
endPhrases.body: I would congratulate you properly, but that seems excessive.

endPhrases.title: You nail it!
endPhrases.body: Please enjoy this really brief moment of relevance.

endPhrases.title: Victory!
endPhrases.body: You have successfully defeated a collection of colored and misplaced squares.

endPhrases.title: Raise the roof!
endPhrases.body: Please remember to thank absolutely no one.

endPhrases.title: Triumph!
endPhrases.body: I was beginning to worry you'd develop minimal critical thinking skills.

endPhrases.title: There you go!
endPhrases.body: Humanity may now rest safely for another five minutes.

endPhrases.title: Pop the cork!
endPhrases.body: At what cost? Probably several seconds of your life.

endPhrases.title: Objective Reached!
endPhrases.body: Congratulations on completing the maze. I'm sure you learned something. Probably.

endPhrases.title: You did it!
endPhrases.body: Unfortunately, there is no achievement for having a life afterward.

endPhrases.title: Puzzle Defeated!
endPhrases.body: Glad you made it this far. I'm just not sure why.

endPhrases.title: You Triumphed!
endPhrases.body: I hope the journey was worth the mild psychological damage.

endPhrases.title: Maze completed!
endPhrases.body: Intelligence had stopped chasing you and somehow you keep running

endPhrases.title: Maze conquered!
endPhrases.body: And somehow the average IQ on your room has decreased
